rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to the icy condition of the walkway, which is a classic liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Serious pediatric injury on insured premises; liability coverage applies with $500,000 limit.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway, broke wrist
